mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_room ( user_id, applicant_type, company_name, job_id, difficulty, language, ai_interviewer_cnt, ai_applicant_cnt, resume_id, resume_file_name, resume_text, portfolio_id, portfolio_file_name, portfolio_text, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{applicantType}, #{companyName}, #{jobId}, #{difficulty}, #{language}, #{aiInterviewerCnt}, #{aiApplicantCnt}, #{resumeId}, #{resumeFileName}, #{resumeText}, #{portfolioId}, #{portfolioFileName}, #{portfolioText}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT ir.room_id, ir.user_id, ir.applicant_type, ir.company_name, ir.job_id, cj.job_name, ir.difficulty, ir.language, ir.ai_interviewer_cnt, ir.ai_applicant_cnt, ir.resume_id, ir.resume_file_name, ir.resume_text, ir.portfolio_id, ir.portfolio_file_name, ir.portfolio_text, ir.status, ir.started_at, ir.ended_at FROM interview_room ir LEFT JOIN category_job cj ON ir.job_id = cj.job_id WHERE ir.room_id = #{roomId} AND ir.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ir.room_id, ir.user_id, ir.applicant_type, ir.company_name, ir.job_id, cj.job_name, ir.difficulty, ir.language, ir.ai_interviewer_cnt, ir.ai_applicant_cnt, ir.status, ir.started_at, ir.ended_at FROM interview_room ir LEFT JOIN category_job cj ON ir.job_id = cj.job_id WHERE ir.user_id = #{userId} AND ir.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ir.started_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_room SET status = #{status}, ended_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') THEN NOW() ELSE ended_at END WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT room_id FROM interview_room WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_room SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE interview_room SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
